{{Top|leg}}
The '''Austringer Flight School''' was a division of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Highly regarded, it focused on preparing [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] that had passed out of [[Flight school/Legends|flight school]] at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] and command training at the [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Prefsbelt IV Academy]] to become [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commanders]]. During his brief service with the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] spent the last part of his training here before passing off as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and commanding a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Flanchard]]''.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
